sources.limits: This is a historical laboratory/instrument result published in 2026, not the rover's current location or an observation from our model. No SAM-like analysis is implemented. PMC full-text access returned an interstitial; rely on the primary JPL report here.

sources.finding: The published spectral stratigraphy distinguishes Al-rich and Fe/Mg-rich clay horizons and competing depositional or alteration interpretations.

sources.limits: Orbital interpretation does not establish access, soil mechanics or sampled mineralogy. This requires another canonical public terrain package, source partition and georegistration review. The USGS warehouse endpoint returned 403; the USGS publication page was accessible.

scope: Retain these as deferred questions in the existing 17-sector catalogue. They neither displace the three predeclared regions nor change any seed, observation or cost in the definitive sweep.
